profile.headline: Lead Web Developer, Manager at Alliant University
profile.summary:
With 10+ years of web development and design experience in both corporate and freelance settings, I’ve been able to hone my experience in strategized wireframing, user-experience, front- and back-end development, responsive web design, and web performance, while building a strong understanding of server- and client-side programming. Skills include:

* HTML5, PHP (5.6), WordPress, CSS (Less, SCSS), JavaScript (ES5, ES6), jQuery, Bootstrap, Foundation
* Create fully custom themes and plug-ins from scratch in PHP for the WordPress CMS
* Optimize performance of high traffic websites 
* Well-versed in responsive web design techniques
* Plan, design, and implement web site structure and layout
* Ability to adapt in fast-paced environment and manage multiple projects
* Experienced in SEO best practices
* Tools: VSCode, Sublime Text 3, SVN, Git (BitBucket), Adobe Creative Suite

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description:
* Independent contractor of web design and web development
* Participated in all aspects of the business: attaining leads, price quoting, design, and development
* Web metrics analyzed for clients using Google Analytics

positions.title: Senior Developer I
positions.description:
* Participated in all phases of a project lifecycle—from discovery and requirements gathering through design collaboration, development, testing, and launch—ensuring solutions aligned with project goals and technical best practices
* Authored custom migration scripts to transfer content between platforms, including migrations from Drupal to WordPress and WordPress to WordPress, ensuring data integrity, consistency, and minimal disruption during site transitions
* Led development and maintenance of complex WordPress multisite ecosystems, supporting multiple brands and stakeholders from a single, scalable codebase
* Integrated Salesforce with WordPress to support data synchronization, forms, and CRM workflows, improving lead management and internal reporting processes

positions.title: Marketing Technology Engineer
positions.description:
* Lead developer tasked to replatform degrees.nau.edu to WordPress within a tight deadline. Utilized the Bootstrap framework along with the Underscores theme starter.
* Experienced with web accessibility (a11y) standards - WCAG 2.0.
* UI Engineer utilizing the Foundation framework for 3inone.com and SheaApartments.com.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
* Lead website redesign developer for velonews.com, runrocknroll.com, and competitor.com
	* Built fully custom themes in WordPress, using the Bootstrap framework’s grid and the Underscores starter theme
	* Created and maintained custom plugins to assist in streamlining editorial processes and extend WordPress functionality
* Maintained and enhanced performance for health & fitness media sites; triathlete.com and womensrunning.com
* Developed several high-visibility landing pages for various one-day sales (runrocknroll.com)

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
* Performed daily maintenance to the corporate and support website
* Worked with a team of designers and developers to create dynamic websites that displayed properly across all modern browsers
* Created pixel-perfect mockups based on client requests
* Customized basic site templates using CSS, HTML, and JavaScript to significantly improve its design level
* Developed company e-mail newsletter templates used by the Marketing Dept
